sloka: तं भूमौ देवसङ्काशं पतितं प्रेक्ष्य राघवम्।अभिपेतुः समुत्पत्य सर्वतः कपिसत्तमाः ।। ६.८३.११ ।।
transliteration: taṁ bhūmau devasaṅkāśaṁ patitaṁ prekṣya rāghavam।abhipetuḥ samutpatya sarvataḥ kapisattamāḥ ।। 6.83.11 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Raghava who is equal to god fallen on the ground, and the best of monkeys lifting him, the Vanaras from all over came jumping.
